_comment: How figures and dates are written. unit.<id>: a figure in its unit, {n} the number already written in the game's
culture (game.json's locale); unit.<id>.name: the unit alone, for a heading. Which unit a figure is read in comes
from the units the player plays in (game.json's locale.units, or the player's pick in Settings): imperial mph, mi,
gal, qt, f, lb, lbft, hp_ton; metric kmh, km, l, c, kg, nm, hp_t; hp in both. A mod can call them its own way (PS
for hp), but the figure is not converted.
In the other text, a number can be named for what it is and is then written in the game's currency or the
{nm:torque}, {hp:power}, {hp:power_weight}; a format after it ({left:fuel:0.0}), and .number for the figure alone
({left:fuel.number}). The figures the game hands over are metric (km/h, km, litres, °C, kg, N·m).
format.*: the patterns of dates and times the screens write, in .NET's date format (MMMM the month's name, d the
day, yyyy the year, h:mm tt the 12-hour clock, HH:mm the 24-hour one); the names are in the game's culture.
